items.name: nav-link
items.title: NavLink
items.description: react-router NavLink with the YoRHa selected-row look. aria-current=page marks the active row. Forwards props and ref so it works as a MenuList row through a render prop.
items.docs: Migration (v4 craft): the row marker is a diamond glyph (hollow / dotted on hover / filled on current), the focus ring is inset, labels carry no uppercase or wide tracking, the current row has no light rules. Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with Square Enix or PlatinumGames. Use inside a react-router data or declarative router. Pass render={<NavLink to=... />} to a Base UI row to reuse the selected-row look.
